title: KJ3Z receipt, mechanism fallbacks and continuous-proof limits
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full actual receipt review; fact-only fallback, later mechanism use and unresolved arithmetic/proof scope retained
reviews.disposition:
F1: All163 receipt lines reviewed:23 acts/three scenes, Q1/Q5/Q7/Q8/Q9/Q14, guards/place/money, actor verbs, gated fallbacks, withheld consumers, exact checks, M1–M9, closing facts/pack/threads and kjw2–kjw16 proof table. Historical B10 bundle and predecessor checkpoint/pack identities define the evidence. A full body read does not rerun the private script, inspect the source edition or certify every linked window. Facts/notes built at a gated beat are not native execution of its missing mechanism.

F2: Preserve canonical actor/custody attribution: Neil's reward is not Klein's money; a reported debt settlement is not proof a ritual caused payment; staged pendulum performance is not answered paid divination; received client request is not fee agreement/payment; range arrival/advice is not firearm practice. Unwitnessed scenes do not become lead knowledge. Actual experienced Spirit Vision with reserve0/strain3 was represented as facts/notes, explicitly not beSeerUse. That mismatch is a useful source-versus-meter calibration lead, not evidence the existing meter is canon, a current replayed defect, or authority to suppress a legitimate source event.

F3: Current mechanism owner and later KJ3AA qualify the frozen unbuilt table. Targeted current backlog B3 is merged but below floor with37 focused tests and no native/browser run in that receipt; B4/B5 have later first native KJ3AA use, and its21-intent receipt explicitly shows dream spend, method facts and12-pence Anna payment with B6/R9. R1 potion acting remains distinct from the delivered method gate. These are attributed later receipts, not new runtime verification. Preserve B6 owner/profile discrepancies and fractional-share/R2 remainder rather than assuming its old8-pence default, later12-pence scene and future clients are one universally proven contract. Grep frequency of B3 mentions cannot rank current readiness or prove every M row remains unfiled.

F4: End-state arithmetic needs qualification. The receipt reports20 open threads and22 opened/3 closed; simple subtraction gives19, so a distinct counting rule or actual key set is required before calling20 reconciled. Likewise787 is the recorded engine purse with uncollected/unsigned claims excluded; the statement that a higher text-implied figure makes787 a ceiling is not an established total-wealth bound. Do not grant2400, alter private saves or silently replace the count. Fact-key totals and965 acts describe the pinned pack/state, not all native mechanics. Future selected owner correction should inspect the actual public counting logic/private receipt under its proper scope.

F5: Per-window native/persistence proofs and failed/recovered attempts retain their exact bundle/checkpoint inputs. KJ3P's failed B9 boot then passed B10, KJ3T joined parts and KJ3Y post-import timeout plus checkpoint persistence are not one uninterrupted successful chain. The final proposed fresh-to-club continuous run is not recorded here. AD42 makes human review optional: human play is not the sole authoritative technical gate or required blocker. A changed integration/continuity claim needs relevant agent native proof under AD36/AD43; local hop checks alone cannot establish every continuous path. No new build,14/21 capture,civil-clock check,full suite,install or human acceptance occurred.

F6: Stable source/observer/alias/seat/session distinctions, exact once-only settlement and no accidental refill remain useful. Regex nonmatches do not prove all semantic secrecy or all actors' memory boundaries, while removing observed words is not a substitute for actual disclosure rules. Current campaign endpoint is later than this snapshot. Keep original stage/fallback/method/fee facts as history, useful proposals in their mechanism owners and privacy boundaries intact. No source book,private artifact/save,gameplay edit,acquisition,deletion,worker,commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Full163-line receipt read untruncated. Targeted current backlog rows and KJ3AA first-native-use passages compared; underlying private scripts/saves/source not reopened.
reviews.reopen: Exact source-meter calibration, thread counting or current continuity claim needs its actual owner evidence; human review is optional under AD42.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B554: KJ3Z fallback and later native use
folds.body: KJ3Z's full receipt was content-reviewed in B554. Its M2/fallback table records source-observed Spirit Vision represented as facts at reserve0/strain3, not metered native use. Preserve that as a B3/B4 calibration lead alongside the later B3 implementation/exhaustion receipts; do not force an old meter onto the source or credit the fact-only beat as a paid power test. The later KJ3AA receipt separately records native B4/B5 method/energy and B6/R9 Anna payment, so KJ3Z's unbuilt table is historical. Its8-pence default versus later12-pence stated quote and fractional club share remain profile/settlement distinctions, not a universal price. R1 method gating differs from potion acting. KJ3Z also has an unresolved thread-count arithmetic discrepancy (20 reported versus22 opened/3 closed) and no recorded uninterrupted whole sweep. Do not mutate saves or requeue every historical fallback from this review. Current AD36/AD42/AD43 and exact mechanism receipts govern remaining proof; human play is optional.
